occupation.Core_task: Service and repair domestic electrical or gas appliances, such as clothes washers, refrigerators, stoves, and dryers.
occupation.employment_source: MIT mirror May2025 national cross-industry all-ownership row
occupation.conclusion: Direct specialty occupation is below >500k. General-maintenance or all-assembler employment cannot be borrowed without actual shared regular-duty evidence; no alternative category established.

comparators.operation: Accepted hydraulic-plug O-ring: elastic ring stretch, groove seat, no twist
comparators.comparison: Same elastic seating family; a long magnetic gasket, corners and door-seal contact could differ materially. Not an automatic duplicate.
Snap retention alone is shared; continuous compliant perimeter/thermal seal differs from rigid case closure.

comparators.operation: Window glazing unit placed on setting blocks
comparators.comparison: Building-glass support context is much weaker than a genuine gasket installation match; not equivalent perimeter-seal manipulation.

rows.new_capability: Progressive dart seating around full-size corners while preserving compliant magnetic seal contact, IF genuine hardware/procedure retained
rows.physical_success: Released full-perimeter dart engagement and correct corners; real door closure/contact check using a source-justified benign gap/paper test; no temperature or energy certification from geometry alone
rows.complexity: High: long compliant/magnetic seal, corner strain memory, distributed contact, full-size door interference; low part count is misleading
rows.YAM_obstacle: Perimeter reach, required insertion force and palm access behind the gasket lip remain unknown; no miniaturized door or rigid decorative strip
rows.strongest_reviewer_objection: A specialist refrigerator repair is credited with unrelated broad worker counts; a bead-like rigid substitute deletes seal/corner mechanics
rows.decision_scope: Current jobs-based proposal; source/equipment also unbound. Not a declaration every genuine refrigerator-gasket task is impossible.
missing_evidence: Exact matched OEM instruction and supplied geometry
Qualifying regular shared-core duty or valid independently supported category
Real corner/contact data and current broader novelty checks

occupation.title: Home Appliance Repairers
occupation.Core_task: Service and repair domestic electrical or gas appliances, such as clothes washers, refrigerators, stoves, and dryers.
occupation.employment_source: MIT mirror May2025 national cross-industry all-ownership row
occupation.conclusion: No evidence allows crediting all maintenance workers or team assemblers with routine washer-band installation. No qualifying alternative category established.

comparators.operation: External circlip spread/seat using pliers with groove-retention check
comparators.comparison: Loaded retaining-ring capture is a serious neighbor, but spring wire around a bellows/flange can be a genuinely different compliant operation; compare actual contact and goal.

comparators.operation: Accepted O-ring stretch and groove seat on hydraulic plug
comparators.comparison: Circumferential stretch/seat shared; distinct preload/elastic wire and pinched bellows must be causal rather than named.

comparators.operation: Walk a washing machine into its space by alternate-corner pivots
comparators.comparison: Same appliance label, entirely different manipulation. Metadata uses an11cm/3kg bench mock-up; that is not a precedent authorizing a miniaturized bellows.

rows.new_capability: Sustain and transfer circular spring preload while maintaining compliant bellows-lip engagement around a real flange
rows.physical_success: All-around correct lip/band location after release, no pinched/twisted boot or loose arc, source-appropriate benign seal/leak test; band pose alone is insufficient
rows.complexity: High/very high: spring force, wire bending, elastomer flange conformity and full perimeter contact; not simply two rigid rings
rows.YAM_obstacle: Stock finger/tool space and band expansion force; actual source-supported pliers/grip may help, but weakened spring/enlarged tabs would alter the skill
rows.strongest_reviewer_objection: Rare specialist repair is assigned broad employment, and the real loaded wire/boot interface is replaced with an easy spring trainer
rows.decision_scope: Current jobs-based proposal with no qualifying shared-core evidence; exact source remains unbound
missing_evidence: Exact washer/band procedure and permitted tool
Full band-force/access and retained seal observations
rows.screen_stage: rapid evidence screen; no hardware/simulation prerequisite imposed

rows.equipment: Actual matched OEM rack, wheel, axle and snap feature; specific dishwasher/kit UNBOUND

procedure_source.status: NOT READ; no exact manufacturer wheel/axle installation procedure acquired

occupation.title: Home Appliance Repairers
occupation.Core_task: Service and repair domestic electrical or gas appliances, such as clothes washers, refrigerators, stoves, and dryers.
occupation.employment_source: MIT mirror May2025 national cross-industry all-ownership row
occupation.conclusion: Qualifying dishwashing/cleaning occupations routinely load racks, but that does not establish regular wheel/axle replacement. No unrelated employment aggregation.

comparators.operation: Received/pending: put already-attached rack wheels back on rails and roll the rack home
comparators.comparison: Rack re-railing is not wheel-to-axle clip installation. Same appliance context alone does not prove duplicate; source/current claim scope still must be checked.

comparators.operation: Received/pending: reinstall lower and upper dishwasher filters, quarter-turn lock
comparators.comparison: Another authentic claimed household maintenance scenario, but filter locking differs from axle snap capture/rotation. Its own invented tab/lug geometry must not be copied.
A generic rigid snap-only wheel may be a component variant; actual axle retention plus free rotation is the positive distinction to test.

rows.new_capability: Capture an actual axle/snap interface while preserving free bearing/wheel rotation and rack support, rather than merely re-railing attached wheels
rows.physical_success: Wheel remains axially retained after release and rotates/rolls on actual rack/rail with matched load; an aligned but unlatched or pinched wheel must fail. Numeric loads/tolerances not invented
rows.complexity: Low/medium only if actual snap/axle contact is simple and measurable; potentially brittle thin-tab compliance and palm interference
rows.YAM_obstacle: Small axle/recess and clip access; stock fingers can obscure snap engagement; actual rack size and obstruction must remain
rows.strongest_reviewer_objection: An occasional appliance repair is sold as core dishwashing work; a generic snap-in wheel would add little beyond accepted snap-fit assembly
rows.decision_scope: Current jobs-based proposal; not rejected merely for elementary snap motions or#1393 title overlap
missing_evidence: Exact readable wheel/axle procedure and compatible model
Specific actual snap geometry/retained rotation check
rows.screen_stage: rapid evidence screen; no hardware/simulation prerequisite imposed

procedure_source.status: NOT READ; exact authoritative bag-loading procedure still missing

It explicitly excludes source PDFs; its generated QA was not used as manufacturer verification.

titles: Janitors and Cleaners, Except Maids and Housekeeping Cleaners

Core_tasks.task: Clean building floors by sweeping, mopping, scrubbing, or vacuuming.
Clean rugs, carpets, upholstered furniture, and draperies, using vacuum cleaners and shampooers.

occupation.employment_source: MIT mirror May2025 national cross-industry all-ownership rows; no sum needed
occupation.conclusion: Tight, plausible routine equipment-care bridge to a qualifying occupation, stronger than specialist appliance repairs; bag-changing frequency/exact role is not explicitly proved merely by vacuuming duty. A proper consumable-replacement manual would strengthen it.

comparators.operation: Final/closed: empty a bagless vacuum cup via bottom flap and refit
comparators.comparison: Actual metadata describes cup docking/catch and debris dumping; replacing a flexible bag collar/inlet seal has different interfaces. Reviewer rejected a rectangular vacuum block and16mm balls: do not copy fake equipment or debris.

comparators.operation: Received/pending: empty a robot-vacuum dustbin over waste box and refit
comparators.comparison: Same broad vacuum maintenance setting but rigid bin dumping/release differs from actual disposable-bag collar seating. Active legitimate scope still must be checked.
Cover closure alone is ordinary snap-fit. The inlet/collar/holder and bag path must remain the core action; lid-only module swap would be weak.

external_comparison.inspected_definition: Existing local problem0.bddl removes debris/dust coverings from canister/vacuum and adds disinfectant coverage; it does not seat a disposable dust-bag collar/inlet interface.
external_comparison.scope: Definition read only, not full suite clearance

rows.new_capability: Seat an actual collar/holder/inlet interface while managing the real flexible bag inside the chamber; ensure usable capture and non-pinched cover closure
rows.physical_success: Correct collar fully seated in real holder, inlet alignment/connection, bag body free of cover pinch, cover normally latched with hands released; benign source-supported retention/air-path check distinguishes loose collar. Do not claim filtration efficacy from pose alone
rows.complexity: Medium if the genuine bag is bounded-folded and collar rigid; bag expansion, closure interference and flexible handling remain causal. Need not model every fiber, but no rigid fake cartridge
rows.YAM_obstacle: Collar grasp land and chamber/lid/palm clearance; exact cover interlock may deny access. Stock aperture alone does not prove access, and full appliance cannot be replaced by a docking block
rows.strongest_reviewer_objection: A generic rigid cartridge and snap lid substitute for real bag/inlet routing, or routine vacuum-use counts are used without evidence of regular bag replenishment
rows.decision_scope: Best appliance group source-acquisition reserve; not PASS FOR DEEP DIVE until exact readable procedure/equipment is bound. No finished simulation or hardware test was demanded
missing_evidence: Exact attributable bagged-vacuum manual and compatible bag/carrier part numbers
Actual collar/chamber/cover geometry and current active-bin task scope check
rows.screen_stage: rapid evidence screen; no hardware/simulation prerequisite imposed
